revisions.request: 现状问题是在优先级1正常的情况下，会突然切入尝试优先级2
revisions.scope: Keep the existing three-failure threshold and fix the confirmed concurrent late-success generation race that can leave a recovered preferred target on backup routing. The provided screenshot alone does not prove this was the only cause of that observed round.
When editing Base URL without allowPrivateNetwork, reuse the current trustedPrivateNetwork setting for validation and persistence; an explicit value still updates the setting.

Register the upstream edit IPC through an injected handler module, matching the repository's GitHub update IPC pattern so sender validation, encoded IDs, token forwarding, and key omission are directly testable.

Independent review found a credential-reference race when a Base URL edit was delayed by DNS validation while a concurrent key rotation completed. Merge edits into the latest stored upstream and retire the credential reference actually replaced; also reject empty Base URLs and validate the current destination when private-network trust is revoked.
